recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If the documents page needs additional DiagnosticReport wording, handle that under the later documents-page tracker rather than reopening this DiagnosticReport ballot clarification.
issue_request: FHIR-5278 was a Published/Persuasive OO DSTU1 ballot comment asking what distinguishes a DiagnosticReport resource from a document bundle that represents a diagnostic report; the disposition requested clarification that the word report does not imply a whole document, though the resource can represent report content conveyed through a document.
initial_application: The clarification appears to have been applied implicitly in 2015. Commit d6259fa8e3 added the sentence that a diagnostic report can be conveyed via Document, RESTful API, or Messaging and that each includes the DiagnosticReport resource itself; commit 3a53283fae corrected the grammar. No Jira-tagged FHIR-5278 commit was found.
additional_context: DiagnosticReport is active in source/fhir.ini. Later Published work in FHIR-29258 added DiagnosticReport.composition for structured organization with Composition, which supports the current distinction rather than contradicting it. A later R6 documents-page issue, FHIR-54513, asks to mention DiagnosticReport on the documents page but is only Resolved - change required and is not part of this applied/published seed scope.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because source/diagnosticreport/diagnosticreport-introduction.xml already contains the needed clarification and nearby boundaries distinguish DiagnosticReport from Observation, Composition, and DocumentReference.

related_jiras.note: Added DiagnosticReport.composition to reference Composition for report structure, reinforcing the separation between DiagnosticReport content and document/Composition organization.
